name: Letter of Commendation
summary: Brother Anton's Letter of Commendation bears his seal and carries the Scarlet Crusade's regard. It directs its bearer from Desolace to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.

sections.title: A Sealed Letter
sections.body: Raleigh the Devout waits in Southshore for the bearer of Brother Anton's letter. The sealed message praises the Scarlet Crusade's strongholds, from Hearthglen to Tirisfal Glades. It declares that the plague's true threat lies in Lordaeron and asks Raleigh to receive the bearer.

faq.answer: Brother Anton gave the Letter of Commendation and sealed it with his mark.
Raleigh the Devout in Southshore is named as the recipient.
The letter commends its bearer to Raleigh and asks him to escort them to a place of honor in the Scarlet Monastery.

faq.q: What does Brother Anton say about the plague?
faq.answer: Brother Anton says the plague's true threat lies in Lordaeron.

faq.q: What does the letter say about the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade claims strongholds from Hearthglen to Tirisfal Glades and calls them bastions of cleansing.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, Southshore is a familiar town where Raleigh the Devout receives Brother Anton's sealed commendation.
